theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_dlb_exists_restricted_varifold
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen Ω → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ Ω → μ (K ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≠ ∞) → ∃ W : Varifold N n Ω, W.measure = c • μ.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
